members.author: Zelys-DFKH
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2514: RequestResponder.cancel() is non-compliant with the MCP cancellation spec: it sends an error JSON-RPC response (forbidden) and never sends notifications/cancelled (required). members.title: fix: make ClientSessionGroup streamable HTTP errors catchable
members.author: VrtxOmega
members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Making `__aenter__`/`__aexit__` on `ClientSessionGroup` reachable by tests and fixing error propagation in streamable HTTP connections. Both PRs modify the same two methods in `session_group.py`. PR #2711 removes `# pragma: no cover` from both method signatures (enabling coverage), while PR #2637 changes the `__aexit__` body from a concurrent `anyio.create_task_group` teardown to a sequential `await exit_stack.aclose()` loop (so AnyIO task contexts are preserved and errors surface), and ships tests that exercise those previously-excluded methods. The pragma removal in #2711 is superseded once #2637's tests exist. (2 PRs)
